input: Map out a week-long silent retreat itinerary

gold.taskTitle: Plan a week-long silent retreat itinerary
gold.taskDescription: Map out a detailed day-by-day itinerary for a seven-day silent retreat.

questions.title: What is the primary tradition or style of the retreat?
questions.description: Understand whether the retreat follows a specific framework such as Vipassana, Zen, Christian contemplative, secular mindfulness, or something else.

questions.title: Where will the retreat be held?
questions.description: Determine the setting — an established retreat center, a rented cabin, the user's own home, or another location.

questions.title: What are the exact start and end dates?
questions.description: Pin down the specific seven-day window so the schedule can be anchored to real days and times.

questions.title: Will you be doing this alone or with a group?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a solo self-guided retreat, a facilitated group retreat, or a small private gathering.

questions.title: What daily practices should the itinerary include?
questions.description: Identify the core activities — sitting meditation, walking meditation, journaling, yoga, chanting, body scans, or other practices.

questions.title: Are there any physical, dietary, or health constraints to consider?
questions.description: Note any limitations such as mobility restrictions, meal preferences, fasting periods, or medical conditions that affect scheduling.

questions.title: What is the intended daily schedule structure?
questions.description: Understand preferred wake and sleep times, session lengths, rest periods, and how strictly structured versus flexible the days should be.
